text:
emma: Quick heads-up — noticed inconsistent terminology between the Console UX and the in-product docs panel. Console list says 'replica pool', quickstart doc panel says 'deployment slot', and API snippets say 'model slot'. Users are getting confused in the onboarding flow. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/console-term-mix.png raj: Oof. Which screens specifically? Is this just copy or are the flows different too? emma: Mostly copy. Screens: Console > Deployments list (uses 'replica pool'), Quickstart side doc panel (uses 'deployment slot'), API reference code samples (uses 'model slot'). UX flow is the same; wording mismatch only. lina: Thanks for flagging. Can we pick a single term? I vote for a neutral, product-agnostic term like 'deployment unit' or 'serving unit' — shorter and maps to pool/slot/replica. ben: From docs POV I prefer 'deployment unit' — it's clearer in step-by-step guides. Also we should add a tiny glossary line in the panel: "deployment unit (aka replica pool / model slot)" so existing users map old terms. sofia: Agree on glossary line. Also: telemetry folks rely on event names, not UI copy, but any rename needs a mapping plan so dashboards don't break. We should add a compat alias for metrics and log queries for 3 months. raj: Accessibility nit: if we change wording in the small panel, ensure the aria-label for the panel heading is explicit (e.g., aria-label="Quickstart: deployment unit (glossary)"). Screen readers currently read the old phrase and it trips a11y tests. ben: Proposed microcopy for panel header and crosslink: ```html

Deployment unit (formerly: replica pool / model slot)

See the docs for routing, quotas, and billing: Deployment units.

``` This keeps it short and preserves discoverability. lina: UX suggestion: add a subtle info icon with a hover tooltip that shows the mapping. For mobile/keyboard users show the mapping inline (no hover-only content). emma: Good point. Also, let's add a deep crosslink from the docs page back to the Console route: "Open in Console -> Deployments" so people can jump from docs to where terms are used. docs-bot: Created ticket DOCS-4124 (docs update) and DESIGN-2789 (console microcopy) — @ben and @lina assigned. sofia: I'll add a short compatibility shim in telemetry: keep old metric names but alias new ones. I'll post the PR once I have it. ben: I'll draft the glossary paragraph and examples today. Lina — can you review the microcopy in the mockup by EOD? lina: Yup, I'll drop comments in the mock and add the accessible markup examples. emma: Plan sounds good. Timeline: patch copy in quickstart doc panel + docs glossary next week, console rollout with feature flag, and telemetry alias for 3 months. I'll coordinate with releases. :thumbsup: raj: Small QA point — let's add a unit test that checks the in-panel link text isn't truncated in narrow widths (we had that bug once). emma: Agreed. Thanks all. We'll close this thread once DESIGN-2789 has the final copy merged.
